source_snapshot.items: BMC I2C-11, temperature sensor and BMC FRU connectivity
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC scan bus10 then forced `i2ctransfer -f -y 10 w1@0x48 0x00 r2`; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect evidence/photos and check logs; no temperature or FRU oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags thermal/force risk but treats the sensor reply as possible FRU evidence and keeps physical acceptance primary.

old_problem: The only command reads sensor0x48; it lacks temperature decoding/tolerance and any separate FRU endpoint, identity/checksum oracle, driver policy or recovery.
disposition_reason: The sensor and FRU are separate read-only objectives. A two-byte0x48 reply cannot establish FRU connectivity, while temperature PASS needs a part-specific signed/scaled decoder and reference tolerance; ED-03/19 prohibit combining these identities or guessing EEPROM content.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row141, same-row AI fields and history2529; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved bus10,0x48,register0x00,r2 and both temperature-sensor and BMC-FRU coverage.
Required a separate bounded FRU header/identity/checksum read and independent temperature correlation.
Rejected blind scan, default force, FRU write/dump, physical-only work, retry and DUT action.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-11 temperature sensor and FRU read-only validation
test_case.purpose: Verify credible temperature telemetry and immutable BMC FRU identity on their distinct bus10 endpoints without disturbing monitoring or EEPROM data.
required_package: PID1114953 bus10 sensor and FRU endpoint map
Sensor part/register0x00 signedness, scale, valid bits and tolerance
FRU safe header/identity offsets, expected fields and checksum rule
Driver ownership and exceptional `-f` approval if needed
test_case.test_command: Do not broad-scan. Prefer hwmon for temperature; if approved, run one bounded0x48/register0x00 read and decode/correlate it with simultaneous telemetry. Separately read only the PID-approved FRU header/identity bytes, validate fields/checksum, and confirm no thermal alarm or EEPROM state change.
test_case.expected_result: Decoded temperature is valid and within approved tolerance of independent telemetry; the separate FRU identity and checksum match the project oracle; monitoring, FRU contents and BMC health remain unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both distinct evidence sets. Raw temperature bytes, missing FRU proof, invalid/out-of-tolerance value, checksum/identity mismatch, NACK/timeout, alarm/monitoring loss or content change fails.
safety_gate: Prefer bound driver interfaces; `-f` needs owner approval.
No broad quick-write scan, threshold change or FRU write/arbitrary dump.
Confirm sensor read has no alert-clearing side effect and FRU offsets are immutable-safe.
Stop on first error without retry/reset and preserve evidence.
expected_evidence: Timestamped raw/decoded temperature plus independent reference
Bounded FRU identity bytes and checksum result
Pre/post alarms, FRU integrity, bus/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Reads should be state-neutral. Preserve evidence and stop on anomaly; use only approved thermal/FRU recovery and never rewrite EEPROM or thresholds to manufacture a pass.

source_conflict.reason: Sensor-only bytes are offered for two devices with no temperature or FRU oracle; prior reviews add unsourced probing.

blocked.reason: Both read-only purposes are clear; endpoint maps/decoders are resolvable RPUC inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Sensor format/tolerance, separate FRU endpoint and checksum oracle, driver-safe access, abort criteria and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve both distinct endpoint contracts and safe read procedures, then revise the record.

project_authority: PID1114953 plus the sensor and FRU format specifications govern the OEM endpoints and expected data.
